intelArticles.title: Reserve Retirement Fairness Act — Tracking Update
intelArticles.summary: Mock tracking article for proposed legislation affecting Reserve retirement eligibility and timing.
intelArticles.whyItMatters: Retirement legislation can change when qualifying Reserve service produces retired-pay eligibility. Salty Dog should distinguish proposals from enacted law and implementation guidance.
intelArticles.details: This is sample IT-1 content for interface testing only. The production article will summarize the latest verified legislative status, explain the Reserve-specific effect, identify what has and has not changed, and link directly to the authoritative source.

intelArticles.title: NDAA Reserve Duty Status Reform
intelArticles.summary: Mock NDAA item showing how Salty Dog can track proposed simplification of Reserve duty categories.
intelArticles.whyItMatters: Any future duty-status reform could affect how IDT, active-duty periods, pay, points, benefits, and app terminology are displayed.
intelArticles.details: This sample article demonstrates the future Intel format: what is being discussed, current legislative status, what would change if enacted, likely implementation dependencies, and which Salty Dog tools might need to be updated.

intelArticles.title: FY27 Military Pay & Drill Pay Watch
intelArticles.summary: Mock pay-watch article for annual military basic-pay and corresponding drill-pay changes.
intelArticles.whyItMatters: Changes to basic pay flow directly into Reserve drill compensation and can affect the Pay Tracker once official tables are published.
intelArticles.details: This placeholder will eventually show the proposed, authorized, and final published pay changes separately so users can tell the difference between an estimate and an effective pay table.

intelArticles.title: Annual Training Requirement Update

intelArticles.details: Production Intel can use this format for NAVADMIN, RESPERSMAN, CNAFR, NRC, or command-level guidance after the source has been verified and the effective date is known.

intelArticles.title: VA Disability Compensation Pay Watch
intelArticles.summary: Mock benefits article for annual VA compensation changes that may affect Reservists receiving disability pay.
intelArticles.whyItMatters: Reserve members receiving VA compensation may want one place to follow annual rate changes and related Reserve drill-pay offset guidance.
intelArticles.details: This IT-1 sample does not state a real rate change. Production content will use verified VA sources and will clearly separate published rates from projections or pending legislation.
